scope_contract: Mechanism (ii) — inspector-side tagging. All file-level findings are tagged with explicit introduced_in_diff: true|false. Untagged/absent findings default to ignore per AC-2.6 (b).
rationale: Diff is a single existing live slash-command docstring (commands/spec.md), 13+/1- via 5 hunks, all additive: (1) frontmatter description extension + new argument-hint; (2) Step 1 --codex flag parser block; (3) three dispatch sites get conditional codex_required: true propagation; (4) Important Rules block gets Section 5 verbatim anti-X-inflation prose. No new files, no deletions, no orphan introduction, no naming violation, no temp/backup pattern, no archive candidate, no obsolete functionality marker, no dead env var, no duplicate content. File is in the canonical ~/.claude/commands/ location and is actively referenced (auto-detected by /dev, /dev-overnight, /dev-command; co-located with agents/spec.md). Referenced artifacts (agents/spec.md, ~/.claude/templates/overnight-spec.md, bin/spec-verify.py, scripts/todo/spec.py) all exist. Verdict: clean — no findings to emit.
